description: Local business lead list. Send what and where, such as dentists in Austin TX; returns up to 20 Google Maps businesses with name, address, phone, website, rating, a domain check (DNS) and the best contact email on the business's own site, email-checked. For lead generation and local business contacts. Emails are role addresses (info@, sales@) the site publishes at its own domain: no personal or guessed ones, no mailbox test. Typical response 5 to 20 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.2 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, lower case, such as us or gb; also puts local phone numbers in E.164.

language.description: Optional language code, lower case, such as en or pt-br.

limit.description: Most leads to return, 1 to 20; the price is the same.

query.description: What kind of business and where, in one string, such as dentists in Austin TX.

name: quantagentshop_lead_list
title: Lead list
